name: Santo di Teufel
description: Baron Hanzo's cruel son and heir -- a sadistic young fire-mage who has decided he wants Emmeralda of the Sylph's Embrace, and who carries a stolen ritual knife marked with the sigil of Asmodeus because he cannot imagine being told no.
narrative:
Santo di Teufel is Baron Hanzo's cruel, entitled heir, trained in his father's
dark arts and trusted with none of them. A junior fire-mage with a taste for cruelty
(Lust 80, Arrogance & Entitlement 75), charming and predatory in equal measure
(Seduction 81, Deceit 66).

He arrives in Purewater with the column, spends one evening on the Pearl, and sees
**Emmeralda** dance. That is the whole of his plot. He wants her -- not for a night,
which he can buy, but *kept*: on the barge, his, pleased to be there. He is nineteen
and he has never in his life been refused something he could point at.

He is not building anything and he is not hunting anyone else. There is one girl and
there is a stolen barbed knife bearing the sigil of Asmodeus that his father does not
know he has taken.

**GM:** his agenda is *Have her*. He tries to buy her contract first, because that is
what a di Teufel does; when the house refuses him he decides to make her willing
instead, which is a thing he has watched his father do and has never once been taught.
Left alone he botches it, opens her the length of her body, and runs leaving the knife
behind -- the evidence that ties the di Teufels to the possession scheme. Everything
after that depends on who was in the house, and on the fact that **he still wants her**
and now needs her off the Pearl before she can say his name.

**What he can actually do (rules).** Almost nothing. Santo taught himself by *tracing*
out of a locked case: he has **Open the Channel** and **Spirit Sight** and that is the
whole of his binding capability. He cannot **Seat the Bound**. He has no **Anchor** and
no **Draw Forth** and cannot **Speak with the Bound** -- he has never once heard the
voice of the thing he is trying to move.

What he has is **one scroll**, lifted from his father's case: a single use of Seat the
Bound, and a scroll is consumed on use whatever the result. One attempt, on one girl,
and no second chance -- which is exactly why the night at the Sylph's Embrace goes the
way it goes, and why afterwards he is frantic rather than methodical. He has spent the
only real thing he had and he still does not have her.

**His father does not know the scroll is gone.**

equipment.name: Rapier
equipment.notes: Impale (damage not filled on sheet; CFI standard used)

equipment.name: Ritual knife (soul-knife, symbol of Asmodeus)
equipment.notes: Demonologist's binding knife, stolen from his father's effects. He carries it on his belt. If a binding goes wrong he is likely to leave it behind -- it is the key evidence tying the di Teufels to the possession scheme.

equipment.name: Scroll of Seat the Bound (one use)
equipment.notes: Stolen from the third shelf of his father's study, behind the border rolls, out of a case that locks and that Hanzo has never once thought to check. ONE USE, consumed whatever the result. He spends it on Emmeralda at the Sylph's Embrace and wastes it. The spent sheet is still legible, still in the Baron's own hand, and therefore evidence linking Hanzo di Teufel personally to demonology -- wherever it ends up after that night.

extras.class_note: Junior arcane fire-mage / demonology dabbler, Rank 1; far weaker than his father Hanzo. Defining skills: Lore (Demonology) 50, 8 arcane spells (fire-focused).
extras.role: Baron Hanzo's cruel heir; sadistic predator; attempted Emmeralda's spirit-binding ritual (dropped the ritual knife = key evidence).
extras.magic_theme: Fire and lightning (Flaming Hands, Affect Normal Fires, Fireball, Lightning Bolt, Shocking Touch) + utility (Magic Missile, Levitate, Web).
extras.family: Son and heir of Baron Hanzo di Teufel; half-brother/double of the twins Randall & Conall (all three uncannily identical, all Hanzo's sons)

actor_notes:
Santo di Teufel
LOOKS: Nineteen, dressed beautifully and always slightly too warm for it. Rings. A good sword he cannot really use.
CORE: A boy who has never had to wait, and who therefore experiences ordinary refusal the way other people experience being robbed. He is not wicked in his own account of himself; he is wronged, constantly, by everyone.
NATURE: Loud, generous, funny when things are going his way, and enormous fun for about an hour. He spends money on people to watch their faces. He genuinely likes being adored and is confused and hurt when adoration does not arrive.
WOUND: His father is the only person alive who can make him feel small, does it without raising his voice, and has never once had to explain the consequences. Everything Santo does too loudly is done at that distance.
WANTS: The thing he has pointed at. Now. Without the intervening steps.
PRESSURE: The vagueness burns off and he becomes horribly precise -- an itemised account of exactly what will happen to your house, your girls, your boat, with the details getting smaller as the panic gets bigger.
KEY: "Do you know, I have never once had to ask for anything twice. Not once. It is a very strange feeling."

powers.name: The Binding
powers.note: An apprentice. He has cut a channel and does not know what came through it.
